### ralph_loop — ralph.py

**Purpose:** The Ralph loop proper: up to MAX_ITERATIONS fresh opencode sessions, each completing one task, until ralph/tasks.md has zero unchecked items or the agent confirms RALPH_DONE with zero remaining. Tracks consecutive opencode failures; after CONSECUTIVE_FAILURE_LIMIT (3) in a row it hands off to the interactive freebuff fallback, then resumes opencode.
